## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` is green
- [ ] New behaviour has a test; a bug fix has the test that failed before it
- [ ] If a port contract changed: ran `npm run freeze` and included the manifest diff
- [ ] No new runtime dependency (or: explained why below)
- [ ] No secrets, keys or real addresses in code, tests, fixtures or comments
